title: A NATO-csatlakozás és hazánk biztonsága (NATO Accession & Collective Defense)
grammar: Constitutional Guarantees, Supranational Integration & Kin-State Registers in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when and how Hungary joined NATO.
I can explain collective defence in one sentence.
I can say that Hungarian soldiers take part in peacekeeping missions.
I can use the words of this lesson about NATO and the army.
